description: Land Acquisition - Moragammana, Aranayaka D/S Division, Kegalle District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1986/04, Baddegama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired (including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and locations), procedures for compensation claims, and amendments to previous land acquisition notices. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it concerns land acquisitions, property descriptions, and land-related administrative procedures.
